name: unsafe fn push < 'a > (& mut self , entry : & 'a mut UnsafeListEntry < T >) -> & 'a T
rule: The caller of `push` must ensure that unwinding does not destroy the stack frame containing the entry before the entry has been removed from the list and the caller who popped it is done using it.
